caption: A New Chapter Begins Official Launch of Shivanisharma Foundation🦋 ​“Small Step,Big Impact” This philosophy is at the core of everything we do. 9th August marked the grand official launch of the Shivani Sharma Foundation, standing united on stage with our leadership, team, dedicated volunteers, and promising young students holding their new laptops. ​This event was more than just a celebration; it was a firm commitment to long-term social change, digital literacy, and community welfare. Through our drive, we equipped 50 young minds with laptops for their digital education and provided sports clothes to promote holistic development among children. ​We are also thrilled to announce that our official website is now live! 🌐 www.shivanisharmafoundation.org This meaningful initiative dedicated to empowering students through education and technology at the Laptop Distribution Ceremony 2026, organised by Shivanisharms Foundation , held at Ravindra Natya Mandir, Mumbai. Hon. Sachin Ahir - Deputy Chairman, Maharashtra Legislative Council Hon. Sanjay Dina Patil - Member of Parliament Hon. Suhail Khandwani - Managing Trustee, Mahim Dargah andHaji Ali Dargah Hon. Yogi Priyavrat Animesh - Founder, Ooj Foundation ,Ratna Bhushan - Social Worker, Foundation Hon. Amit Tiwari - Youth Leader, Entrepreneur and Social Worker, Hon. Sunil Ahir - Former Corporator, BMC, Hon. Manisha Tupe - Trustee, Shri Siddhivinayak Ganpati Temple Trust Our Mission : The Shivanisharma Foundation was founded on a simple belief: Inequality Is Not Inevitable, it can Be Changed. We envision a world where every woman knows her worth, every child has access to education, healthcare is within reach and many more. Through our work, we strive to create a future built on dignity, empowerment, and hope for all. 50 Laptops. 50 Futures. Small Step. Big Impact. Jai Hind! 🇮🇳 ​#shivanisharmafoundation #officialfoundationlaunch #smallstepbigimpact #50laptop50future #shivanisharma❤️

ShivaniSharma Foundation 🦋 honoured to welcome Hon’ble Aishwarya Sangeeta Sachin Ahir, Founder of Maitree Foundation as the Chief Guest for its inaugural initiative dedicated to empowering deserving students through the distribution of 50 laptops, aimed at supporting education and building a brighter future. A distinguished leader, compassionate social reformer, and dedicated changemaker, Hon’ble Aishwarya Sangeeta Sachin Ahir has consistently worked towards uplifting society through impactful initiatives in education, women empowerment, and community development. Her unwavering commitment to service and nation-building continues to inspire countless individuals across all sections of society. We are privileged to have him grace this occasion and share his valuable thoughts and guidance with an esteemed gathering of students, educators, social leaders, entrepreneurs, and changemakers committed to empowering youth through education and creating meaningful opportunities for a brighter future Honoured to be part of this meaningful initiative dedicated to empowering students through education and technology at the Laptop Distribution Ceremony 2026, organised by Shivanisharms Foundation , held at Ravindra Natya Mandir, Mumbai. Our Mission : The Shivanisharma Foundation was founded on a simple belief: Inequality Is Not Inevitable, it can Be Changed. We envision a world where every woman knows her worth, every child has access to education, healthcare is within reach and many more. Through our work, we strive to create a future built on dignity, empowerment, and hope for all 50 Laptops. 50 Futures. Small Step. Big Impact.🇮🇳 ​#ShivaniSharmaFoundation #OfficialFoundationLaunch #smallstepbigimpact

कृतज्ञता आणि मनःपूर्वक आभार 🙏 दोन दिवसांपूर्वी @shivanisharmafoundation अधिकृत लॉन्चिंग सोहळ्याला उपस्थित राहण्याचा मान मिळाला. या निमित्ताने पहिल्याच टप्प्यात ५० गरजू विद्यार्थ्यांना ५० लॅपटॉपचे वाटप करण्यात आले. विद्यार्थ्यांना आधुनिक तंत्रज्ञानाच्या माध्यमातून अधिक चांगले शिक्षण घेता यावे आणि त्यांच्या उज्ज्वल भविष्यासाठी नवी दिशा मिळावी, हा या उपक्रमामागचा सुंदर उद्देश आहे. 💻📚 या कार्यक्रमासाठी फाउंडेशनच्या अध्यक्षा @shivanisharma_officia यांनी मला आवर्जून आमंत्रित केले, याबद्दल मी त्यांचा मनःपूर्वक आभारी आहे. तसेच माननीय @shivsenaofc शिंदे गटाचे आमदार @sachinahir8775 यांच्या हस्ते माझा @rahulborole सत्कार करून मला दिलेला मानसन्मान माझ्यासाठी अत्यंत भावनिक आणि अभिमानाचा क्षण होता. 🙏 या प्रेमासाठी आणि सन्मानासाठी शिवानी शर्मा फाउंडेशनच्या संपूर्ण टीमचे मनःपूर्वक आभार! ❤️ समाजातील गरजू विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी आणि समाजाच्या उज्ज्वल भविष्यासाठी फाउंडेशनचे हे सेवाकार्य असेच अविरत सुरू राहो, यासाठी आई तुळजाभवानीच्या चरणी मनःपूर्वक प्रार्थना करतो. 🙏🚩 सेवा हीच खरी साधना… आणि शिक्षण हीच उज्ज्वल भविष्याची गुरुकिल्ली! 🌱✨ #ShivaniSharmaFoundation #EducationForAll #LaptopDistribution #SocialWork #StudentEmpowerment
